text:
Avery: Support ticket: console shows route-pinned model in header but saved queries are clearly for a different model. Users get confused during fallbacks.

Sam: Current rule: saved queries are route-scoped only. No model scope exists.

Diego: Telemetry alignment problem too — cost-preview and token breakdown are route-based. If runtime served a cheaper quantized variant, cost numbers are off when you view the model page.

Nora (Design): Proposal: introduce an explicit scope control in header: [Scope: Route v] with options Route / Model / Team / Global. Default stays Route. Selecting Model sends model_id to savedqueries endpoint and switches telemetry window to serve-attribution stream.

Avery: Good. Also add a tiny badge when actual served model != pinned model: "served: redwood-lite (fallback)" with hover that shows serve % over last 24h and a CTA "view by served model".

Rohit (Backend): We'll need DB: nullable model_id on saved_queries + index (route_id, model_id). Add model_id param to /api/savedqueries. Backfill lazy on read.

Sam: Precedence when model scope selected: 1) model-scoped savedqueries, 2) route-scoped, 3) team/global. Return ranked list.

Diego: Eng-ML needs to expose per-model cost profiles and serve-attribution sampling. I can add an API endpoint serve-attribution?route_id=..&window=24h.

deploy-bot: [deploy] console v2.9.5 canary with savedqueries scope flag (2%): https://ci.redwood/console/1466 :rocket:

Nora (Design): I'll mock the scope chip + badge and preserve any active query builder filters when switching scope.

Avery: Action items: Rohit RFC for DB + API, Diego to expose attribution endpoint, Nora mock, Sam to update savedqueries search ranking. Let's reconvene after mocks.

Rohit (Backend): Opening RFC now. Will include sample SQL and lazy backfill plan.

Avery: thanks all — tagging this thread in the weekly product sync if there are blockers. :thumbsup:
